🇧🇷 🇺🇦 Brazilian Muay Thai champion killed fighting alongside Ukrainian forces Gustavo Ferro, a 31-year-old Brazilian and three-time Muay Thai champion who travelled to Ukraine to fight alongside the Ukrainian Armed Forces, has reportedly been killed. According to reports citing his relatives, Ferro died on November 26 alongside the rest of his unit following a drone strike. He had arrived in Ukraine in August and was already wounded by shrapnel during a drone attack in September. Despite his earlier injuries, he subsequently returned to the front line. His family is now reportedly facing difficulties in securing the return of his remains to Brazil, with relatives expressing concerns about the Ukrainian military command’s willingness to facilitate the repatriation. Another foreign mercenary whose journey to Ukraine ended in death. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

🇺🇦 🇵🇱 Ukrainian caught smuggling nearly eight metres of python skin into Poland Polish customs officers at the Medyka–Shehyni border crossing intercepted a 59-year-old Ukrainian man attempting to smuggle two python skins, measuring 3.6 and 4.6 metres respectively, into Poland. The man had concealed one skin inside his luggage and the other underneath his jacket. However, customs officers detected the unusual cargo using a specialist scanner. Both skins were seized, and the man faces a potential fine of 1,000 Polish zlotys. He could also face up to five years in prison over the attempted smuggling. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
